motion.name: model-card-selection
motion.purpose: Changes outline and fill on hover and selection. Disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary start button
components.description: Starts conversion for the selected model.
components.css: .ds-start{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:38px;padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font:600 0.75rem/1.3 var(--studio-font, Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);background:var(--studio-ink, #24232b);color:var(--studio-paper, #ffffff);border-color:var(--studio-ink, #24232b)}.ds-start:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--studio-accent, #63469e);color:var(--studio-on-accent, #ffffff);border-color:var(--studio-accent, #63469e)}.ds-start:disabled{color:var(--studio-muted, #615e6b);opacity:.65;cursor:default}.ds-start:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--studio-accent, #63469e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Utility button
components.description: Secondary button for managing models and opening settings.
components.css: .ds-utility{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:38px;padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font:600 0.75rem/1.3 var(--studio-font, Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);background:var(--studio-paper, #ffffff);color:var(--studio-ink, #24232b);border-color:var(--studio-line, #e6e2eb)}.ds-utility:is(:hover,[aria-pressed=true]):not(:disabled){color:var(--studio-accent, #63469e);border-color:var(--studio-accent, #63469e)}.ds-utility[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--studio-tint, #f0ebfa)}.ds-utility:disabled{color:var(--studio-muted, #615e6b);opacity:.65;cursor:default}.ds-utility:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--studio-accent, #63469e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected sort option
components.description: Pill options indicate which model sort order is active.
components.css: .ds-sort{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:38px;padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font:600 0.75rem/1.3 var(--studio-font, Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);background:var(--studio-paper, #ffffff);color:var(--studio-ink, #24232b);border-color:var(--studio-line, #e6e2eb)}.ds-sort:is(:hover,[aria-pressed=true]):not(:disabled){color:var(--studio-accent, #63469e);border-color:var(--studio-accent, #63469e)}.ds-sort[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--studio-tint, #f0ebfa)}.ds-sort:disabled{color:var(--studio-muted, #615e6b);opacity:.65;cursor:default}.ds-sort:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--studio-accent, #63469e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Audio device field
components.description: Compact field for choosing the input device.
components.css: .ds-device-label{color:var(--studio-muted, #615e6b);font:.875rem/1.55 var(--studio-font, Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)}.ds-device{min-height:30px;padding:3px 7px;border:1px solid var(--studio-line, #e6e2eb);border-radius:7px;color:var(--studio-ink, #24232b);background:var(--studio-paper, #ffffff);font:inherit}.ds-device:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--studio-accent, #63469e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected voice card
components.description: An artwork slot with the selection check and model caption.

components.name: Live status
components.description: A green dot and status text indicate active conversion.

components.name: Model manager frame
components.description: Scrollable paper dialog with a sticky title.
components.html: Manage models
components.css: .ds-dialog{width:min(100%,48rem);max-height:90dvh;overflow:auto;border-radius:var(--studio-radius,16px);background:var(--studio-paper, #ffffff);color:var(--studio-ink, #24232b);box-shadow:0 16px 54px rgb(25 18 39 / 24%);font:.875rem/1.55 var(--studio-font, Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)}.ds-dialog-title{position:sticky;top:0;margin:0;padding:15px 20px;background:var(--studio-paper, #ffffff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--studio-line, #e6e2eb);font-size:1.12rem;font-weight:600}.ds-dialog-body{padding:12px 20px}.ds-dialog-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:38px;padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font:600 0.75rem/1.3 var(--studio-font, Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);background:var(--studio-paper, #ffffff);color:var(--studio-ink, #24232b);border-color:var(--studio-line, #e6e2eb)}.ds-dialog-action:is(:hover,[aria-pressed=true]):not(:disabled){color:var(--studio-accent, #63469e);border-color:var(--studio-accent, #63469e)}.ds-dialog-action[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--studio-tint, #f0ebfa)}.ds-dialog-action:disabled{color:var(--studio-muted, #615e6b);opacity:.65;cursor:default}.ds-dialog-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--studio-accent, #63469e); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The workspace uses model artwork as the first cue for choosing a voice. White panels frame the library and settings, while lilac groups the active conversion tools. In dark mode, charcoal and plum preserve the same hierarchy.

Poppins gives the display title and compact control labels a consistent voice. Fine borders group settings and a diffuse shadow separates dialogs from the workspace.
keyCharacteristics: A large centered title and compact utility header
Pill actions, rounded panels, and explicit selection states

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Use accent for selection and focus. Reserve green, amber, and rose for live state and timing feedback.

rules.name: The Tonal Panels Rule
rules.body: Keep library, session, and settings panels flat. Use the ambient shadow on the outer dialog frame.

dos: Do use the installed model artwork for the library thumbnail and selected portrait.
Do pair the selected treatment with a visible check on model cards and an accessible pressed state.
Do keep timing figures tabular as their values change.
donts: Don't crop the selected portrait with the library thumbnail treatment.
